text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
My heart is racing!! Power is surging 
through me!!
The world is shining brighter 
than ever before!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I feel like running right this instant... 
No, I'm going to run!!

Huh!? There's still time left, isn...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Even so! I can't stay still any longer! 
The voice of destiny is telling me so!
choice_data_list: Huh?! We still have time... right?!
Huh?! We still have time... right?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer,
come with us too!! Let's 
go! Right away! Right now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I managed to calm her down as she tried
to 
dash off, and we waited for the race to 
begin.
